name: Temple of the Moon
summary: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides her people from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The sanctuary is the seat of government on Teldrassil and home to the Sisterhood of Elune, whose priestesses tend a sacred moonwell.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Built soon after the Third War, the Temple of the Moon rose as the night elves settled Teldrassil. It is among the largest stone structures made by modern kaldorei hands. Its marble came from quarries on the Kalimdor mainland and crossed the sea by magical means. At the heart of the temple, a broad moonwell rests beneath the statue of Haidene. Pilgrims come to worship and reflect beside its consecrated waters. The temple also holds Darnassus's highest seat of government, where High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides her people through a new age.

sections.title: The Sisterhood's Bastion
sections.body: The priestesses of the Sisterhood of Elune serve their goddess from the temple's terraces, in worship and in the field. Emissaries and dispatched sisters travel across northern Kalimdor to investigate threats or aid local sentinels. Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, for example, makes inquiries along the Darkshore coastline. Novices and veteran priestesses gather beneath the starry vaulted ceiling to learn divine spellwork, tend the wounded, and guard the sanctum from outside corruption.

faq.q: Who leads the Temple of the Moon?
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind presides over the Temple of the Moon. She leads the Sisterhood of Elune and heads the kaldorei government, guiding Darnassus in spiritual and military affairs.

faq.q: How was the temple built on Teldrassil?
aliases: how was temple of the moon built
faq.answer: Teldrassil grew from boughs across the ocean, but the Temple of the Moon was built of stone. Its marble and masonry came from the Kalimdor mainland and reached the world tree's summit by magical means.

faq.q: What is the pool in the center of the temple?
aliases: water in temple of the moon
faq.answer: The pool at the temple's center is a sacred moonwell beneath the statue of Haidene. The Sisterhood uses its consecrated waters for cleansing rites, meditation, and restorative magic, and reveres them as a blessing of Elune.

faq.q: What services can players find here?
aliases: what is in temple of elune
faq.answer: Priests train at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind also gives guidance there, and the Sisterhood sends adventurers on assignments.

angles.text: For an Alliance priest, especially a night elf, the Temple of the Moon is the foremost source of Elune's divine mandate and home to the highest priestly trainers.
For a night elf, the Temple of the Moon brings together kaldorei civic and spiritual life, the Sisterhood of Elune, and Teldrassil's government.
